title: Sum the Range
goal: Add up the numbers 1 through 5, including 5.
hints: A range written with two dots stops before its last number.
The sum has to keep what it already had.
explanation: `1..5` counts 1, 2, 3, 4 and stops before 5, giving 10. Both `1..=5` and `1..6` include 5 and give 15, so either earns the star. The operator must accumulate: `sum = n` throws away everything counted so far, and `-=` subtracts.
